reason: The switch at the console is the only offered action, and commanding ascent is the goal.
expectation: I expect the command to begin the ascent, though I don't know how the departure will unfold.

effect: The command launched the cabin, completing the ascent goal and leaving the repaired support on Mars.
reaction: The cave and panels shrinking together made the departure feel like a satisfying farewell.

mostWorthwhile.text: Pressing the ascent switch was worthwhile for the departure image, which brought the expedition's shelter and power system into view together.

leastWorthwhile.text: The single action offered no meaningful choice, although it fit the final command.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; ascent was the expected result.

arbitrary.text: The switch had a clear purpose, though it was the only offered action.

continue.text: I would continue to see what the laboratories learn from the specimens, though this brief chapter offered little gameplay beyond the departure.
